"""Confirmed-swing trend pullbacks with a closed M5 range break."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import time
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import pandas as pd
from pydantic import Field

from app.core.enums import Action, ExitReason, Side, Timeframe
from app.indicators.volatility import atr
from app.strategy.base_strategy import BaseStrategy, StrategyParams
from app.strategy.signal_models import (
    Condition,
    OpenPosition,
    PositionAdvice,
    ReasonCode,
    Signal,
    StrategyContext,
)
from app.strategy.zigzag import Swing, zigzag

BANGKOK = ZoneInfo("Asia/Bangkok")
NEW_YORK = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")


class TrendBoxParams(StrategyParams):
    """Measured constants shared by the two trend directions."""

    buffer: float = Field(default=0.20, ge=0, le=2)
    min_r: float = Field(default=1.2, gt=0, le=10)
    # Owner 2026-10-27: "you can take the 5 USD out". Measured first (research/.../gate_bite.py): the
    # 5.00 USD floor rejected 1 of 496 complete signals, because every target here is a swing or half an
    # H4 box. The gate stays so a lane can set one; 0.0 is off.
    min_take_profit: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0)
    # The measured default differs per direction, so each subclass sets its own; a lever either way
    # (journal 2026-10-27: a down trade reached +1.40 R and still stopped out at -1.01 R).
    break_even: bool = False
    require_big_tf: bool = False
    min_stop_atr: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0)


class TrendBoxDownParams(TrendBoxParams):
    box: float = Field(default=0.20, gt=0, le=1)


class TrendBoxUpParams(TrendBoxParams):
    box: float = Field(default=0.33, gt=0, le=1)
    break_even: bool = True


def in_window(at: pd.Timestamp) -> bool:
    """Research windows use a start-exclusive, end-inclusive close timestamp."""
    utc = at.tz_convert("UTC")
    bangkok = utc.tz_convert(BANGKOK)
    new_york = utc.tz_convert(NEW_YORK)
    bt, nt = bangkok.time(), new_york.time()
    return (time(7) < bt <= time(9)) or (time(13) < bt <= time(15)) or (time(8) < nt <= time(11, 30))


def stepped(swings: list[Swing]) -> str:
    highs = [s.price for s in swings if s.kind == 1]
    lows = [s.price for s in swings if s.kind == -1]
    if len(highs) < 2 or len(lows) < 2:
        return "FLAT"
    if highs[-1] < highs[-2] and lows[-1] < lows[-2]:
        return "DOWN"
    if highs[-1] > highs[-2] and lows[-1] > lows[-2]:
        return "UP"
    return "FLAT"


def running_push_exceeded(run: float, risk: float) -> bool:
    """Apply the measured strict 1.2 R cutoff to the preceding M1 run."""
    return run > 1.2 * risk


def break_even_advice(ctx: StrategyContext, pos: OpenPosition) -> PositionAdvice | None:
    """Replay closed M1 bars so a stop crossed before a threshold touch keeps precedence."""
    if (pos.side is Side.BUY and pos.sl >= pos.entry) or (pos.side is Side.SELL and pos.sl <= pos.entry):
        return None
    m1 = ctx.frame(Timeframe.M1)
    bars = m1[(m1.index >= pd.Timestamp(pos.entry_time)) & (m1.index <= pd.Timestamp(ctx.decision_time_utc))]
    risk = abs(pos.initial_sl - pos.entry)
    if risk <= 0 or bars.empty:
        return None
    sell = pos.side is Side.SELL
    stop = pos.sl
    moved = False
    highs = bars["high"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    lows = bars["low"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    for high, low in zip(highs, lows, strict=True):
        if (high >= stop) if sell else (low <= stop):
            return None
        if pos.tp is not None and ((low <= pos.tp) if sell else (high >= pos.tp)):
            return None
        ahead = pos.entry - low if sell else high - pos.entry
        if ahead >= 0.5 * risk:
            stop = pos.entry
            moved = True
    if not moved:
        return None
    return PositionAdvice(new_sl=pos.entry, stop_kind=ExitReason.BREAK_EVEN, note="+0.5 R touched")


class TrendBox(BaseStrategy):
    """Shared confirmed H1 swing, M5 box and running-push gates."""

    Params = TrendBoxParams
    direction: str

    def required_timeframes(self) -> tuple[Timeframe, ...]:
        return Timeframe.M1, Timeframe.M5, Timeframe.H1

    def warmup_bars(self) -> int:
        return 1200 if self.params.require_big_tf else 400

    def evaluate(self, ctx: StrategyContext) -> Signal:
        at = pd.Timestamp(ctx.decision_time_utc)
        h1_frame = ctx.frame(Timeframe.H1)
        h1 = h1_frame.iloc[-400:]
        m5 = ctx.frame(Timeframe.M5)
        m1 = ctx.frame(Timeframe.M1)
        if len(h1) < 400 or len(m5) < 25 or not len(m1):
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA)
        if not in_window(at):
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.OUTSIDE_SESSION)
        swings, _forming = zigzag(h1.high.to_numpy(float), h1.low.to_numpy(float))
        highs = [s for s in swings if s.kind == 1]
        lows = [s for s in swings if s.kind == -1]
        down = self.direction == "DOWN"
        stepping = (
            len(highs) >= 2
            and len(lows) >= 2
            and (
                (highs[-1].price < highs[-2].price and lows[-1].price < lows[-2].price)
                if down
                else (highs[-1].price > highs[-2].price and lows[-1].price > lows[-2].price)
            )
        )
        if not stepping or len(swings) < 2:
            return self.hold(ctx, "TREND_STEPPING")
        if self.params.require_big_tf:
            # Imported at use time because range_break reuses the trend box helpers above.
            from app.strategy.range_break import RangeBreak

            h4 = RangeBreak._h4_from_h1(h1_frame)
            h4 = h4[(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at].iloc[-300:]
            if len(h4) < 300:
                return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA)
            h4_swings, _h4_forming = zigzag(h4.high.to_numpy(float), h4.low.to_numpy(float))
            h4_direction = stepped(h4_swings)
            if (down and h4_direction == "UP") or (not down and h4_direction == "DOWN"):
                return self.hold(ctx, "H4_AGAINST")
        a, b = swings[-2:]
        if (a.kind, b.kind) != ((1, -1) if down else (-1, 1)):
            return self.hold(ctx, "LEG_ORDER")
        leg = abs(a.price - b.price)
        if leg <= 0:
            return self.hold(ctx, "ZERO_LEG")
        decision = m5.iloc[-1]
        price = float(decision.close)
        selected: tuple[int, float, float] | None = None
        for n in range(24, 5, -1):
            if len(m5) < n + 1:
                continue
            box = m5.iloc[-n - 1 : -1]
            top, floor = float(box.high.max()), float(box.low.min())
            if top - floor <= self.params.box * leg:
                selected = n, top, floor
                break
        if selected is None:
            return self.hold(ctx, "NO_BOX")
        _n, top, floor = selected
        mid = (top + floor) / 2
        retr = (mid - b.price) / leg if down else (b.price - mid) / leg
        if not 0.382 <= retr <= 0.786:
            return self.hold(ctx, "RETRACE")
        if (down and price >= floor) or (not down and price <= top):
            return self.hold(ctx, "NO_CLOSE_BREAK")
        stop = (
            top + self.params.buffer * (top - floor) if down else floor - self.params.buffer * (top - floor)
        )
        stop_floor = 0.0
        stop_widened = False
        if self.params.min_stop_atr > 0:
            closed_h1 = h1_frame[h1_frame.index <= at]
            atr_values = atr(closed_h1.high, closed_h1.low, closed_h1.close, 14)
            atr_value = float(atr_values.iloc[-1]) if len(atr_values) else float("nan")
            if pd.isna(atr_value):
                return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA)
            stop_floor = self.params.min_stop_atr * atr_value
            if abs(stop - price) < stop_floor:
                stop = price + stop_floor if down else price - stop_floor
                stop_widened = True
        target = b.price
        risk, reward = abs(stop - price), abs(target - price)
        if reward < self.params.min_take_profit or reward < self.params.min_r * risk:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.RR_TOO_LOW)
        if (down and target >= price) or (not down and target <= price) or risk <= 0:
            return self.hold(ctx, "INVALID_GEOMETRY")
        run_frame = m1[(m1.index >= at - pd.Timedelta(minutes=60)) & (m1.index < at)]
        if run_frame.empty:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA)
        run = price - float(run_frame.low.min()) if down else float(run_frame.high.max()) - price
        if running_push_exceeded(run, risk):
            return self.hold(ctx, "RUNNING_PUSH")
        action = Action.SELL if down else Action.BUY
        conditions = [
            Condition("stepping", True),
            Condition("box", True, detail=f"{_n} bars"),
            Condition("retrace", True, detail=f"{retr:.3f}"),
            Condition("trigger", True),
            Condition("run_gate", True, detail=f"{run:.2f} <= {1.2 * risk:.2f}"),
        ]
        if stop_widened:
            conditions.append(Condition("stop_floor", True, detail=f"{stop_floor:.2f}"))
        return self.entry(
            ctx,
            action,
            entry_price=price,
            stop_loss=stop,
            take_profit=target,
            conditions=conditions,
            score=80,
            explanation=f"{self.direction.lower()} confirmed-swing box break",
        )

    def should_close(self, ctx: StrategyContext, side: Side) -> bool:
        at = pd.Timestamp(ctx.decision_time_utc).tz_convert(BANGKOK)
        return at.time() == time(7)

    def manage_position(self, ctx: StrategyContext, pos: OpenPosition) -> PositionAdvice | None:
        if not self.params.break_even:
            return None
        return break_even_advice(ctx, pos)


class TrendBoxDown(TrendBox):
    name = "trend_box_down"
    Params = TrendBoxDownParams
    direction = "DOWN"


class TrendBoxUp(TrendBox):
    name = "trend_box_up"
    Params = TrendBoxUpParams
    direction = "UP"

+"""Crash-safe mutation check for the two opt-in trend box levers.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv\\Scripts\\python research\\2026-10-26-three-bots\\plant_bugs_2.py``.
+Each mutation is restored byte-for-byte, including leftovers from an interrupted prior run.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess  # nosec B404 - runs this repo's own pytest
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BACKUP = HERE / ".plant_bugs_2_backup"
+TREND = "app/strategy/trend_box.py"
+TEST = "tests/unit/test_strategy_trend_box.py"
+
+BUGS: list[tuple[str, bytes, bytes, str]] = [
+    (
+        "enable the big time frame lever by default",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = False",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = True",
+        "test_big_tf_off_keeps_an_opposing_h4_out_of_the_decision",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let an up H4 trend pass a down box",
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "FLAT")',
+        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let a down H4 trend pass an up box",
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "DOWN")',
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        "test_big_tf_up_blocks_down_h4",
+    ),
+    (
+        "accept only 299 closed H4 bars",
+        b"if len(h4) < 300:",
+        b"if len(h4) < 299:",
+        "test_big_tf_requires_300_closed_h4_bars",
+    ),
+    (
+        "allow a still-forming H4 bar into ZigZag",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)",
+        "test_big_tf_does_not_send_a_forming_h4_bar_to_zigzag",
+    ),
+    (
+        "widen a stop whose distance equals the ATR floor",
+        b"if abs(stop - price) < stop_floor:",
+        b"if abs(stop - price) <= stop_floor:",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_does_not_widen_a_stop_exactly_at_the_floor",
+    ),
+    (
+        "move a BUY stop away from the entry in the wrong direction",
+        b"stop = price + stop_floor if down else price - stop_floor",
+        b"stop = price + stop_floor if down else price + stop_floor",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_mirrors_the_buy_stop_direction",
+    ),
+    (
+        "halve the configured ATR stop floor",
+        b"stop_floor = self.params.min_stop_atr * atr_value",
+        b"stop_floor = 0.5 * self.params.min_stop_atr * atr_value",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor",
+    ),
+    (
+        "omit the stop floor condition from widened entries",
+        b"if stop_widened:",
+        b"if False:",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor",
+    ),
+    (
+        "run the reward-risk check against box width instead of widened risk",
+        b"reward < self.params.min_r * risk",
+        b"reward < self.params.min_r * abs(top - floor)",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widening_is_included_in_the_min_r_gate",
+    ),
+]
+
+
+def pytest(case: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+    return subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", f"{TEST}::{case}"],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+def restore_any() -> None:
+    if not BACKUP.exists():
+        return
+    for parked in sorted(BACKUP.glob("*.bak")):
+        relpath = parked.with_suffix("").name.replace("__", "/")
+        (ROOT / relpath).write_bytes(parked.read_bytes())
+        parked.unlink()
+        print(f"restored {relpath} from an interrupted run")
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    restore_any()
+    baseline = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", TEST],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    if baseline.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"trend box tests failed before mutation checks:\n{baseline.stdout}\n{baseline.stderr}")
+
+    BACKUP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    target = ROOT / TREND
+    results: list[str] = []
+    try:
+        clean = target.read_bytes()
+        parked = BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")
+        parked.write_bytes(clean)
+        for name, old, new, case in BUGS:
+            current = target.read_bytes()
+            if current.count(old) != 1 or old == new:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"mutation anchor is not unique for: {name}")
+            try:
+                target.write_bytes(current.replace(old, new, 1))
+                outcome = pytest(case)
+                caught = outcome.returncode != 0
+                results.append(f"{'CAUGHT' if caught else 'MISSED'} | {case} | {name}")
+            finally:
+                target.write_bytes(clean)
+        count = sum(result.startswith("CAUGHT") for result in results)
+        output = "\n".join([*results, f"{count}/{len(BUGS)} caught"]) + "\n"
+        (HERE / "plant_bugs_2_output.txt").write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
+        print(output, end="")
+        return 0 if count == len(BUGS) else 1
+    finally:
+        target.write_bytes((BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).read_bytes())
+        (BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+            BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+    assert next(condition.detail for condition in got.conditions if condition.name == "stop_floor") == "2.00"
+
+    wide_ctx = context()
+    wide = TrendBoxDown(params).evaluate(_with_h1(wide_ctx, high=101.0))
+    assert wide.action is Action.SELL and wide.stop_loss == pytest.approx(112.0)
+    assert not any(condition.name == "stop_floor" for condition in wide.conditions)
+

+def test_min_stop_atr_mirrors_the_buy_stop_direction(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
+    up = [Swing(1, 100, -1), Swing(2, 110, 1), Swing(3, 101, -1), Swing(4, 120, 1)]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "zigzag", lambda *_args: (up, None))
+    ctx = context()

+    m5.iloc[:-1, m5.columns.get_loc("low")] = 107.0

+    m1 = ctx.frame(Timeframe.M1).copy()

+    ctx = StrategyContext(ctx.market, {**ctx.frames, Timeframe.M5: m5, Timeframe.M1: m1}, ctx.now_utc)
+    ctx = _with_h1(ctx, high=101.0)
+    got = TrendBoxUp(TrendBoxUp.Params(min_stop_atr=1.5)).evaluate(ctx)
+    # ATR=2.00, so this BUY's 3.00 floor moves the stop to 108.10 - 3.00.
+    assert got.action is Action.BUY and got.stop_loss == pytest.approx(105.1)
+    assert next(condition.detail for condition in got.conditions if condition.name == "stop_floor") == "3.00"

"""Crash-safe mutation check for the two opt-in trend box levers.

Run from the repository root with ``.venv\\Scripts\\python research\\2026-10-26-three-bots\\plant_bugs_2.py``.
Each mutation is restored byte-for-byte, including leftovers from an interrupted prior run.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess  # nosec B404 - runs this repo's own pytest
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BACKUP = HERE / ".plant_bugs_2_backup"
TREND = "app/strategy/trend_box.py"
TEST = "tests/unit/test_strategy_trend_box.py"

BUGS: list[tuple[str, bytes, bytes, str]] = [
    (
        "enable the big time frame lever by default",
        b"require_big_tf: bool = False",
        b"require_big_tf: bool = True",
        "test_big_tf_off_keeps_an_opposing_h4_out_of_the_decision",
    ),
    (
        "let an up H4 trend pass a down box",
        b'(down and h4_direction == "UP")',
        b'(down and h4_direction == "FLAT")',
        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
    ),
    (
        "let a down H4 trend pass an up box",
        b'(not down and h4_direction == "DOWN")',
        b'(not down and h4_direction == "UP")',
        "test_big_tf_up_blocks_down_h4",
    ),
    (
        "accept only 299 closed H4 bars",
        b"if len(h4) < 300:",
        b"if len(h4) < 299:",
        "test_big_tf_requires_300_closed_h4_bars",
    ),
    (
        "allow a still-forming H4 bar into ZigZag",
        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at",
        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)",
        "test_big_tf_does_not_send_a_forming_h4_bar_to_zigzag",
    ),
    (
        "widen a stop whose distance equals the ATR floor",
        b"if abs(stop - price) < stop_floor:",
        b"if abs(stop - price) <= stop_floor:",
        "test_min_stop_atr_does_not_widen_a_stop_exactly_at_the_floor",
    ),
    (
        "move a BUY stop away from the entry in the wrong direction",
        b"stop = price + stop_floor if down else price - stop_floor",
        b"stop = price + stop_floor if down else price + stop_floor",
        "test_min_stop_atr_mirrors_the_buy_stop_direction",
    ),
    (
        "halve the configured ATR stop floor",
        b"stop_floor = self.params.min_stop_atr * atr_value",
        b"stop_floor = 0.5 * self.params.min_stop_atr * atr_value",
        "test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor",
    ),
    (
        "omit the stop floor condition from widened entries",
        b"if stop_widened:",
        b"if False:",
        "test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor",
    ),
    (
        "run the reward-risk check against box width instead of widened risk",
        b"reward < self.params.min_r * risk",
        b"reward < self.params.min_r * abs(top - floor)",
        "test_min_stop_atr_widening_is_included_in_the_min_r_gate",
    ),
]


def pytest(case: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", f"{TEST}::{case}"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=False,
    )


def restore_any() -> None:
    if not BACKUP.exists():
        return
    for parked in sorted(BACKUP.glob("*.bak")):
        relpath = parked.with_suffix("").name.replace("__", "/")
        (ROOT / relpath).write_bytes(parked.read_bytes())
        parked.unlink()
        print(f"restored {relpath} from an interrupted run")


def main() -> int:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    restore_any()
    baseline = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", TEST],
        cwd=ROOT,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=False,
    )
    if baseline.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"trend box tests failed before mutation checks:\n{baseline.stdout}\n{baseline.stderr}"
        )

    BACKUP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    target = ROOT / TREND
    results: list[str] = []
    try:
        clean = target.read_bytes()
        parked = BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")
        parked.write_bytes(clean)
        for name, old, new, case in BUGS:
            current = target.read_bytes()
            if current.count(old) != 1 or old == new:
                raise RuntimeError(f"mutation anchor is not unique for: {name}")
            try:
                target.write_bytes(current.replace(old, new, 1))
                outcome = pytest(case)
                caught = outcome.returncode != 0
                results.append(f"{'CAUGHT' if caught else 'MISSED'} | {case} | {name}")
            finally:
                target.write_bytes(clean)
        count = sum(result.startswith("CAUGHT") for result in results)
        output = "\n".join([*results, f"{count}/{len(BUGS)} caught"]) + "\n"
        (HERE / "plant_bugs_2_output.txt").write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
        print(output, end="")
        return 0 if count == len(BUGS) else 1
    finally:
        target.write_bytes((BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).read_bytes())
        (BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).unlink(missing_ok=True)
        if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
            BACKUP.rmdir()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

+    idx = pd.date_range(end=end.replace(minute=0), periods=bars, freq="1h")
+    h1 = pd.DataFrame({"open": 100.0, "high": high, "low": 99.0, "close": 100.0}, index=idx)
+    return StrategyContext(ctx.market, {**ctx.frames, Timeframe.H1: h1}, ctx.now_utc)

+def test_big_tf_off_keeps_an_opposing_h4_out_of_the_decision(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):

+        {**ctx.frames, Timeframe.H1: h1, Timeframe.M5: m5, Timeframe.M1: m1},
+        at + timedelta(seconds=3),
+    )
+    seen_h4: list[float] = []
+
+    calls = 0
+
+    def capture(high, _low):
+        nonlocal calls
+        calls += 1
+        if calls > 1:
+            seen_h4.extend(float(value) for value in high)
+        return down_swings(), None
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "zigzag", capture)
+    TrendBoxDown(TrendBoxDown.Params(require_big_tf=True)).evaluate(changed)
+    assert len(seen_h4) == 300
+    assert 999.0 not in seen_h4
+
+
+def _tiny_box_context() -> StrategyContext:
+    ctx = context()
+    m5 = ctx.frame(Timeframe.M5).copy()
+    m5.iloc[:-1, m5.columns.get_loc("high")] = 100.0
+    m5.iloc[:-1, m5.columns.get_loc("low")] = 99.5
+    m5.iloc[-1, m5.columns.get_loc("close")] = 99.49
+    m1 = ctx.frame(Timeframe.M1).copy()
+    m1["low"] = 99.49
+    return StrategyContext(ctx.market, {**ctx.frames, Timeframe.M5: m5, Timeframe.M1: m1}, ctx.now_utc)
+
+
+def test_min_stop_atr_off_leaves_a_tiny_box_stop_unchanged(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "zigzag", lambda *_args: (down_swings(), None))
+    got = TrendBoxDown().evaluate(_tiny_box_context())
+    assert got.action is Action.SELL and got.stop_loss == pytest.approx(100.1)
+    assert not any(condition.name == "stop_floor" for condition in got.conditions)
+
+
+def test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "zigzag", lambda *_args: (down_swings(), None))
+    ctx = _with_h1(_tiny_box_context(), high=101.0)
+    params = TrendBoxDown.Params(min_stop_atr=1.0)
+    got = TrendBoxDown(params).evaluate(ctx)
+    # Constant H=101, L=99, C=100 yields a 2.00 Wilder ATR; the stop must sit 2.00 above 99.49.
+    assert got.action is Action.SELL and got.stop_loss == pytest.approx(101.49)
+    assert next(condition.detail for condition in got.conditions if condition.name == "stop_floor") == "2.00"
+
+    wide_ctx = context()
+    wide = TrendBoxDown(params).evaluate(_with_h1(wide_ctx, high=101.0))
+    assert wide.action is Action.SELL and wide.stop_loss == pytest.approx(112.0)
+    assert not any(condition.name == "stop_floor" for condition in wide.conditions)
+
+

+def test_min_stop_atr_does_not_widen_a_stop_exactly_at_the_floor(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):

PINNED_RISK = {
    "max_risk_per_trade_percent": 0.5,
    "max_total_open_risk_percent": 1.5,
    "max_daily_loss_percent": 2.0,
    "max_weekly_loss_percent": 4.0,
}


def pin(cfg: AppConfig) -> AppConfig:
    return cfg.model_copy(update={"risk": cfg.risk.model_copy(update=PINNED_RISK)})


def pinned_config() -> Path:
    """The repository's config.yaml with :data:`PINNED_RISK`, in a temporary file."""
    raw = yaml.safe_load(Path("config.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    raw["risk"] |= PINNED_RISK
    path = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="taa-samples-")) / "config.yaml"
    path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(raw, sort_keys=False), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    return path

def backtest_runs(engine_id: str, owner_id: str) -> list[BacktestRunRow]:
    """A real cloud run on the synthetic history (in a throwaway database), plus a copy and a failed run."""
    scratch = Database("sqlite://")
    scratch.create_all()
    runner = BacktestRig(scratch)
    m15 = upload(scratch, engine=engine_id)
    run = runner.service.create(owner_id, engine_id, runner.request(m15), created_by="alice")
    runner.run()
    done = runner.row(run["run_id"])
    assert done.status == "DONE", done.error
    columns = {c.key: getattr(done, c.key) for c in BacktestRunRow.__table__.columns}
    # signal ids are random per run: fixed ones keep the samples file stable
    columns["trades"] = [t | {"signal_id": f"sig-{i}"} for i, t in enumerate(done.trades)]
    later = timedelta(minutes=5)
    return [
        BacktestRunRow(**columns | {"run_id": RUN_A, "job_id": None}),
        BacktestRunRow(
            **columns
            | {
                "run_id": RUN_B,
                "job_id": None,
                "preset": "high_costs",
                "request": columns["request"] | {"preset": "high_costs"},
                "created_at": done.created_at + later,
            }
        ),
        BacktestRunRow(
            **columns
            | {
                "run_id": RUN_F,
                "job_id": None,
                "status": "FAILED",
                "progress": 0.0,
                "error": "no M15 history for GBPUSD on FBS-Demo",
                "summary": {},
                "equity": [],
                "trades": [],
                "trades_total": 0,
                "created_at": done.created_at + 2 * later,
            }
        ),
    ]


def ranking_rows(engine_id: str) -> list[SuitabilitySnapshotRow]:
    """A real ranking run on the multi-asset FakeMT5 (in a throwaway database) for a small account, so some
    symbols fail the minimum-lot gate ("needs equity â‰¥ $Z")."""
    scratch = Database("sqlite://")
    scratch.create_all()
    svc, _, fake = ranking_service(scratch, pin(RANKING_CONFIG))
    fake.account.balance = 1_000.0
    assert svc.tick() is not None
    rows = svc.latest()
    columns = [c.key for c in SuitabilitySnapshotRow.__table__.columns if c.key not in ("id", "engine_id")]
    return [SuitabilitySnapshotRow(engine_id=engine_id, **{c: getattr(r, c) for c in columns}) for r in rows]


def copy_rows(rows: list[Any], engine_id: str) -> list[Any]:
    """Detached copies of *rows* (from a throwaway database) for *engine_id*, without autoincrement ids."""
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        model = type(r)
        columns = [
            c.key for c in model.__table__.columns if c.key != "engine_id" and c.autoincrement is not True
        ]
        out.append(model(engine_id=engine_id, **{c: getattr(r, c) for c in columns}))
    return out


def pin_ids(rows: list[Any], ids: list[str]) -> None:
    """Replace random ids (uuid7 decision and signal ids) everywhere in *rows* by fixed ones."""
    fixed = {old: f"0191a0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000001{i:02d}" for i, old in enumerate(ids)}

    def swap(value: Any) -> Any:
        text = json.dumps(value)
        for old, new in fixed.items():
            text = text.replace(old, new)
        return json.loads(text)

    for row in rows:
        for column in type(row).__table__.columns:
            value = getattr(row, column.key)
            if isinstance(value, str | dict | list):
                setattr(row, column.key, swap(value))


def opportunity_rows(engine_id: str) -> list[Any]:
    """Two opportunities from the engine's scanner on FakeMT5 with every detector (the EURUSD one alerted and
    ACTIVE), with their ADVISORY decision records."""
    scratch = Database("sqlite://")
    scratch.create_all()
    req = ComputeRequirements(("EURUSD", "XAUUSD"), frozenset(evidence_registry().ids), REQ.strategies)
    svc, _, _ = scanner(scratch, req=req, cfg=pin(scanner_config(budget=60.0)))
    assert len(svc.tick().created) == 2
    with scratch.session() as sess:
        opps = list(sess.scalars(select(OpportunityRow).order_by(OpportunityRow.symbol)))
        decisions = list(sess.scalars(select(DecisionRecordRow)))
        checks = list(sess.scalars(select(DecisionCheckRow)))
        rows = copy_rows([*opps, *decisions, *checks], engine_id)
    pin_ids(rows, [o.decision_id for o in opps] + [str(o.signal["signal_id"]) for o in opps])
    eur = rows[0]
    assert isinstance(eur, OpportunityRow) and eur.opportunity_id == OPP_EUR
    eur.status, eur.alerted_at = "ACTIVE", eur.created_at  # as the personalizer leaves an alerted one
    for opp in rows[:2]:  # the window the lifecycle tracker sets (bar close + 2 entry bars)
        assert isinstance(opp, OpportunityRow)
        opp.valid_until, opp.valid_reason = opp.bar_close_at + timedelta(minutes=30), "SIGNAL_LIFETIME"
    eur.features = dict(eur.features) | {INFORMATIVE: 0.8}  # a feature the sample calibration knows
    return rows

SHADOWS = [

    ("r3", "REPLAY", "GBPUSD", "BUY", "LONDON_NY_OVERLAP", 88.0, "TAKE_PROFIT", 2.0, 1.9, 19.0, 12, False, False),
]  # fmt: skip


def shadow_samples(db: Database) -> None:
    """Closed PLAN trades of :data:`SHADOWS`, a MANAGED copy of the first and one still open."""
    rows = []
    for i, (
        oid,
        source,
        symbol,
        side,
        session,
        strength,
        reason,
        r,
        r_net,
        money,
        hours,
        alerted,
        followed,
    ) in enumerate(SHADOWS):
        buy = side == "BUY"
        facts = SignalFacts(
            opportunity_id=oid, source=source, server="FBS-Demo", strategy="example_trend_pullback",
            symbol=symbol, asset_class="METAL" if symbol == "XAUUSD" else "FOREX_MAJOR", timeframe="M15",
            side=side, session=session, setup_strength=strength, rr=2.0,
            features={INFORMATIVE: 0.9} if r > 0 else {}, atr=0.001, signal_at=T - timedelta(days=5) + timedelta(hours=6 * i),
            lot=None if money is None else 0.1, equity=1_000.0, currency="USD", alerted=alerted, followed=followed,
        )  # fmt: skip
        entry, risk = 1.1, 0.005 if buy else -0.005
        for variant in (Variant.PLAN, Variant.MANAGED) if oid == "s1" else (Variant.PLAN,):
            state = new_state(
                side=Side(side), entry=entry, entry_at=facts.signal_at, sl=entry - risk, tp=entry + 2 * risk,
                time_stop=timedelta(hours=72),
            )  # fmt: skip
            row = new_row(
                facts, variant, state, EntryQuote(entry - 0.0001, entry, 1.0, 1.0), (), facts.signal_at
            )
            exit_ = ShadowExit(ExitReason[reason], entry + r * risk, facts.signal_at + timedelta(hours=hours))
            gross = None if money is None else 10.0 * r
            result = ShadowResult(
                r > 0, r, r_net, -0.4, max(r, 0.3), 0, gross, None if money is None else -0.7, 0.0, money,
                None if money is None else 10.0, frozenset(),
            )  # fmt: skip
            apply_close(row, exit_, result)
            rows.append(row)
    open_facts = dataclasses.replace(
        facts, opportunity_id="s6", source="LIVE", signal_at=T - timedelta(hours=2)
    )
    state = new_state(side=Side.SELL, entry=1.1, entry_at=open_facts.signal_at, sl=1.105, tp=1.09,
                      time_stop=timedelta(hours=72))  # fmt: skip
    rows.append(new_row(open_facts, Variant.PLAN, state, EntryQuote(1.0999, 1.1, 1.0, 1.0), (), T))
    with db.session() as sess:
        sess.add_all(rows)


def calibrate(db: Database, engine_id: str) -> None:
    """A calibration version (synthetic outcomes where the Fibonacci theory is informative) stamped on the
    opportunities, and the shadow trades of :data:`SHADOWS` for the accuracy pages."""
    version = save(db, build(outcomes(1500, informative=True, seed=4), CFG, server="FBS-Demo", built_at=T))
    shadow_samples(db)
    with db.session() as sess:
        for model in (CalibrationTableRow, EvidenceModelVersionRow, ShadowTradeRow):
            sess.execute(update(model).where(model.engine_id == "local").values(engine_id=engine_id))
        sess.execute(
            update(OpportunityRow)
            .where(OpportunityRow.engine_id == engine_id)
            .values(calibration_version=version)
        )


def realistic_rows(db: Database, engine_id: str) -> None:

# Values that differ between runs (the audit hash covers the random engine id; the sample run row is stamped
# with the wall clock), replaced by fixed values of the same shape.
VOLATILE = {
    "verified_hash": "0" * 64,
    "started_at": T.isoformat(),
    "session_id": "0191a0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000e1",  # a login's random id
}


def normalize(value: Any, engine_id: str, users: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> Any:
    """Random engine and user ids become ``ENGINE`` and *users*' placeholders (id â†’ name) and volatile values
    fixed ones, so the file is stable."""

    def fix(node: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(node, dict):
            return {k: VOLATILE[k] if k in VOLATILE else fix(v) for k, v in node.items()}
        if isinstance(node, list):
            return [fix(v) for v in node]
        return node

    text = json.dumps(value).replace(engine_id, "ENGINE")
    for user_id, name in (users or {}).items():
        text = text.replace(user_id, name)
    return fix(json.loads(text))


def test_api_samples_match_the_shared_file(
    rig: tuple[TestClient, str, str],  # noqa: F811
    db: Database,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    client, mine, _ = rig
    pinned = load_app_config(pinned_config())  # the cloud reads config.yaml too: same pinned risk
    for module in ("app.web.routers.advisory", "app.worker.opportunities", "app.worker.backtests"):
        monkeypatch.setattr(f"{module}.load_app_config", lambda *_a, **_k: pinned)
    realistic_rows(db, mine)
    calibrate(db, mine)
    # H4 bars for the market map (TAA-L809): seeded, so the sample is stable
    SqlHistoryStore(db, mine).save("FBS-Demo", "EURUSD", Timeframe.H4, h4_candles(500))
    samples: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for route in ENGINE_ROUTES:
        resp = client.get(f"/api/v1/engines/{mine}/{route}")
        assert resp.status_code == 200, (route, resp.text)
        samples[f"engines/ENGINE/{route}"] = normalize(resp.json(), mine)
    user_id = client.get("/api/v1/auth/session").json()["user"]["id"]
    listed = client.get("/api/v1/admin/users").json()["items"]
    users = {u["id"]: "USER" if u["id"] == user_id else f"USER_{u['username'].upper()}" for u in listed}
    for route in USER_ROUTES:
        resp = client.get(f"/api/v1/{route.replace('USER', user_id)}")
        assert resp.status_code == 200, (route, resp.text)
        samples[route] = normalize(resp.json(), mine, users)
    text = json.dumps(samples, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
    if os.environ.get("TAA_UPDATE_API_SAMPLES") == "1":
        SAMPLES.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        SAMPLES.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    assert SAMPLES.exists(), "run with TAA_UPDATE_API_SAMPLES=1 to create the samples file"
    assert SAMPLES.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == text, (
        "API responses changed: check the PWA schemas, then regenerate with TAA_UPDATE_API_SAMPLES=1"
    )

+"""Crash-safe mutation check for the two opt-in trend box levers.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv\\Scripts\\python research\\2026-10-26-three-bots\\plant_bugs_2.py``.
+Each mutation is restored byte-for-byte, including leftovers from an interrupted prior run.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess  # nosec B404 - runs this repo's own pytest
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BACKUP = HERE / ".plant_bugs_2_backup"
+TREND = "app/strategy/trend_box.py"
+TEST = "tests/unit/test_strategy_trend_box.py"
+
+BUGS: list[tuple[str, bytes, bytes, str]] = [
+    (
+        "enable the big time frame lever by default",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = False",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = True",
+        "test_big_tf_off_keeps_an_opposing_h4_out_of_the_decision",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let an up H4 trend pass a down box",
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "FLAT")',
+        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let a down H4 trend pass an up box",
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "DOWN")',
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        "test_big_tf_up_blocks_down_h4",
+    ),
+    (
+        "accept only 299 closed H4 bars",
+        b"if len(h4) < 300:",
+        b"if len(h4) < 299:",
+        "test_big_tf_requires_300_closed_h4_bars",
+    ),
+    (
+        "allow a still-forming H4 bar into ZigZag",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)",
+        "test_big_tf_does_not_send_a_forming_h4_bar_to_zigzag",
+    ),
+    (
+        "widen a stop whose distance equals the ATR floor",
+        b"if abs(stop - price) < stop_floor:",
+        b"if abs(stop - price) <= stop_floor:",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_does_not_widen_a_stop_exactly_at_the_floor",
+    ),
+    (
+        "move a BUY stop away from the entry in the wrong direction",
+        b"stop = price + stop_floor if down else price - stop_floor",
+        b"stop = price + stop_floor if down else price + stop_floor",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_mirrors_the_buy_stop_direction",
+    ),
+    (
+        "halve the configured ATR stop floor",
+        b"stop_floor = self.params.min_stop_atr * atr_value",
+        b"stop_floor = 0.5 * self.params.min_stop_atr * atr_value",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor",
+    ),
+    (
+        "omit the stop floor condition from widened entries",
+        b"if stop_widened:",
+        b"if False:",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor",
+    ),
+    (
+        "run the reward-risk check against box width instead of widened risk",
+        b"reward < self.params.min_r * risk",
+        b"reward < self.params.min_r * abs(top - floor)",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widening_is_included_in_the_min_r_gate",
+    ),
+]
+
+
+def pytest(case: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+    return subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed interpreter and pytest arguments; case is a constant in this file
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", f"{TEST}::{case}"],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+def restore_any() -> None:
+    if not BACKUP.exists():
+        return
+    for parked in sorted(BACKUP.glob("*.bak")):
+        relpath = parked.with_suffix("").name.replace("__", "/")
+        (ROOT / relpath).write_bytes(parked.read_bytes())
+        parked.unlink()
+        sys.stdout.write(f"restored {relpath} from an interrupted run\n")
+    if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+        BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    restore_any()
+    baseline = subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed interpreter, pytest module and repository-owned test path
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", TEST],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    if baseline.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"trend box tests failed before mutation checks:\n{baseline.stdout}\n{baseline.stderr}"
+        )
+
+    BACKUP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    target = ROOT / TREND
+    results: list[str] = []
+    try:
+        clean = target.read_bytes()
+        parked = BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")
+        parked.write_bytes(clean)
+        for name, old, new, case in BUGS:
+            current = target.read_bytes()
+            if current.count(old) != 1 or old == new:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"mutation anchor is not unique for: {name}")
+            try:
+                target.write_bytes(current.replace(old, new, 1))
+                outcome = pytest(case)
+                caught = outcome.returncode != 0
+                results.append(f"{'CAUGHT' if caught else 'MISSED'} | {case} | {name}")
+            finally:
+                target.write_bytes(clean)
+        count = sum(result.startswith("CAUGHT") for result in results)
+        output = "\n".join([*results, f"{count}/{len(BUGS)} caught"]) + "\n"
+        (HERE / "plant_bugs_2_output.txt").write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
+        sys.stdout.write(output)
+        return 0 if count == len(BUGS) else 1
+    finally:
+        target.write_bytes((BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).read_bytes())
+        (BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+            BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Crash-safe mutation check for the two opt-in trend box levers.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv\\Scripts\\python research\\2026-10-26-three-bots\\plant_bugs_2.py``.
+Each mutation is restored byte-for-byte, including leftovers from an interrupted prior run.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess  # nosec B404 - runs this repo's own pytest
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BACKUP = HERE / ".plant_bugs_2_backup"
+TREND = "app/strategy/trend_box.py"
+TEST = "tests/unit/test_strategy_trend_box.py"
+
+BUGS: list[tuple[str, bytes, bytes, str]] = [
+    (
+        "enable the big time frame lever by default",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = False",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = True",
+        "test_big_tf_off_keeps_an_opposing_h4_out_of_the_decision",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let an up H4 trend pass a down box",
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "FLAT")',
+        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let a down H4 trend pass an up box",
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "DOWN")',
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        "test_big_tf_up_blocks_down_h4",
+    ),
+    (
+        "accept only 299 closed H4 bars",
+        b"if len(h4) < 300:",
+        b"if len(h4) < 299:",
+        "test_big_tf_requires_300_closed_h4_bars",
+    ),
+    (
+        "allow a still-forming H4 bar into ZigZag",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)",
+        "test_big_tf_does_not_send_a_forming_h4_bar_to_zigzag",
+    ),
+    (
+        "widen a stop whose distance equals the ATR floor",
+        b"if abs(stop - price) < stop_floor:",
+        b"if abs(stop - price) <= stop_floor:",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_does_not_widen_a_stop_exactly_at_the_floor",
+    ),
+    (
+        "move a BUY stop away from the entry in the wrong direction",
+        b"stop = price + stop_floor if down else price - stop_floor",
+        b"stop = price + stop_floor if down else price + stop_floor",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_mirrors_the_buy_stop_direction",
+    ),
+    (
+        "halve the configured ATR stop floor",
+        b"stop_floor = self.params.min_stop_atr * atr_value",
+        b"stop_floor = 0.5 * self.params.min_stop_atr * atr_value",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor",
+    ),
+    (
+        "omit the stop floor condition from widened entries",
+        b"if stop_widened:",
+        b"if False:",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor",
+    ),
+    (
+        "run the reward-risk check against box width instead of widened risk",
+        b"reward < self.params.min_r * risk",
+        b"reward < self.params.min_r * abs(top - floor)",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widening_is_included_in_the_min_r_gate",
+    ),
+]
+
+
+def pytest(case: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+    return subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed interpreter and pytest arguments; case is a constant in this file
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", f"{TEST}::{case}"],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+def restore_any() -> None:
+    if not BACKUP.exists():
+        return
+    for parked in sorted(BACKUP.glob("*.bak")):
+        relpath = parked.with_suffix("").name.replace("__", "/")
+        (ROOT / relpath).write_bytes(parked.read_bytes())
+        parked.unlink()
+        sys.stdout.write(f"restored {relpath} from an interrupted run\n")
+    if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+        BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    restore_any()
+    baseline = subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed interpreter, pytest module and repository-owned test path
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", TEST],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    if baseline.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"trend box tests failed before mutation checks:\n{baseline.stdout}\n{baseline.stderr}"
+        )
+
+    BACKUP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    target = ROOT / TREND
+    results: list[str] = []
+    try:
+        clean = target.read_bytes()
+        parked = BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")
+        parked.write_bytes(clean)
+        for name, old, new, case in BUGS:
+            current = target.read_bytes()
+            if current.count(old) != 1 or old == new:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"mutation anchor is not unique for: {name}")
+            try:
+                target.write_bytes(current.replace(old, new, 1))
+                outcome = pytest(case)
+                caught = outcome.returncode != 0
+                results.append(f"{'CAUGHT' if caught else 'MISSED'} | {case} | {name}")
+            finally:
+                target.write_bytes(clean)
+        count = sum(result.startswith("CAUGHT") for result in results)
+        output = "\n".join([*results, f"{count}/{len(BUGS)} caught"]) + "\n"
+        (HERE / "plant_bugs_2_output.txt").write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
+        sys.stdout.write(output)
+        return 0 if count == len(BUGS) else 1
+    finally:
+        target.write_bytes((BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).read_bytes())
+        (BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+            BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Crash-safe mutation check for the two opt-in trend box levers.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv\\Scripts\\python research\\2026-10-26-three-bots\\plant_bugs_2.py``.
+Each mutation is restored byte-for-byte, including leftovers from an interrupted prior run.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess  # nosec B404 - runs this repo's own pytest
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BACKUP = HERE / ".plant_bugs_2_backup"
+TREND = "app/strategy/trend_box.py"
+TEST = "tests/unit/test_strategy_trend_box.py"
+
+BUGS: list[tuple[str, bytes, bytes, str]] = [
+    (
+        "enable the big time frame lever by default",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = False",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = True",
+        "test_big_tf_off_keeps_an_opposing_h4_out_of_the_decision",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let an up H4 trend pass a down box",
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "FLAT")',
+        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let a down H4 trend pass an up box",
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "DOWN")',
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        "test_big_tf_up_blocks_down_h4",
+    ),
+    (
+        "leave the H1 warmup too short to build 300 H4 bars",
+        b"return 1200 if self.params.require_big_tf else 400",
+        b"return 400",
+        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
+    ),
+    (
+        "accept only 299 closed H4 bars",
+        b"if len(h4) < 300:",
+        b"if len(h4) < 299:",
+        "test_big_tf_requires_300_closed_h4_bars",
+    ),
+    (
+        "allow a still-forming H4 bar into ZigZag",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)",
+        "test_big_tf_does_not_send_a_forming_h4_bar_to_zigzag",
+    ),
+    (
+        "widen a stop whose distance equals the ATR floor",
+        b"if abs(stop - price) < stop_floor:",
+        b"if abs(stop - price) <= stop_floor:",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_does_not_widen_a_stop_exactly_at_the_floor",

+    (
+        "move a BUY stop away from the entry in the wrong direction",
+        b"stop = price + stop_floor if down else price - stop_floor",
+        b"stop = price + stop_floor if down else price + stop_floor",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_mirrors_the_buy_stop_direction",
+    ),
+    (
+        "halve the configured ATR stop floor",
+        b"stop_floor = self.params.min_stop_atr * atr_value",
+        b"stop_floor = 0.5 * self.params.min_stop_atr * atr_value",

+        "omit the stop floor condition from widened entries",
+        b"if stop_widened:",
+        b"if False:",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor",
+    ),
+    (
+        "run the reward-risk check against box width instead of widened risk",
+        b"reward < self.params.min_r * risk",
+        b"reward < self.params.min_r * abs(top - floor)",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widening_is_included_in_the_min_r_gate",
+    ),
+]
+
+
+def pytest(case: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+    return subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed interpreter and pytest arguments; case is a constant in this file
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", f"{TEST}::{case}"],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+def restore_any() -> None:
+    if not BACKUP.exists():
+        return
+    for parked in sorted(BACKUP.glob("*.bak")):
+        relpath = parked.with_suffix("").name.replace("__", "/")
+        (ROOT / relpath).write_bytes(parked.read_bytes())
+        parked.unlink()
+        sys.stdout.write(f"restored {relpath} from an interrupted run\n")
+    if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+        BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    restore_any()
+    baseline = subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed interpreter, pytest module and repository-owned test path
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", TEST],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    if baseline.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"trend box tests failed before mutation checks:\n{baseline.stdout}\n{baseline.stderr}"
+        )
+
+    BACKUP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    target = ROOT / TREND
+    results: list[str] = []
+    try:
+        clean = target.read_bytes()
+        parked = BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")
+        parked.write_bytes(clean)
+        for name, old, new, case in BUGS:
+            current = target.read_bytes()
+            if current.count(old) != 1 or old == new:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"mutation anchor is not unique for: {name}")
+            try:
+                target.write_bytes(current.replace(old, new, 1))
+                outcome = pytest(case)
+                caught = outcome.returncode != 0
+                results.append(f"{'CAUGHT' if caught else 'MISSED'} | {case} | {name}")
+            finally:
+                target.write_bytes(clean)
+        count = sum(result.startswith("CAUGHT") for result in results)
+        output = "\n".join([*results, f"{count}/{len(BUGS)} caught"]) + "\n"
+        (HERE / "plant_bugs_2_output.txt").write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
+        sys.stdout.write(output)
+        return 0 if count == len(BUGS) else 1
+    finally:
+        target.write_bytes((BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).read_bytes())
+        (BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+            BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Crash-safe mutation check for the two opt-in trend box levers.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv\\Scripts\\python research\\2026-10-26-three-bots\\plant_bugs_2.py``.
+Each mutation is restored byte-for-byte, including leftovers from an interrupted prior run.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess  # nosec B404 - runs this repo's own pytest
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BACKUP = HERE / ".plant_bugs_2_backup"
+TREND = "app/strategy/trend_box.py"
+TEST = "tests/unit/test_strategy_trend_box.py"
+
+BUGS: list[tuple[str, bytes, bytes, str]] = [
+    (
+        "enable the big time frame lever by default",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = False",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = True",
+        "test_big_tf_off_keeps_an_opposing_h4_out_of_the_decision",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let an up H4 trend pass a down box",
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "FLAT")',
+        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let a down H4 trend pass an up box",
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "DOWN")',
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        "test_big_tf_up_blocks_down_h4",
+    ),
+    (
+        "leave the H1 warmup too short to build 300 H4 bars",
+        b"return 1200 if self.params.require_big_tf else 400",
+        b"return 400",
+        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
+    ),
+    (
+        "accept only 299 closed H4 bars",
+        b"if len(h4) < 300:",
+        b"if len(h4) < 299:",
+        "test_big_tf_requires_300_closed_h4_bars",
+    ),
+    (
+        "allow a still-forming H4 bar into ZigZag",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)",
+        "test_big_tf_does_not_send_a_forming_h4_bar_to_zigzag",
+    ),

+        b"if abs(stop - price) < stop_floor:",

+        b"stop = price + stop_floor if down else price + stop_floor",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_mirrors_the_buy_stop_direction",

+        "omit the stop floor condition from widened entries",
+        b"if stop_widened:",
+        b"if False:",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor",
+    ),
+    (
+        "run the reward-risk check against box width instead of widened risk",
+        b"reward < self.params.min_r * risk",
+        b"reward < self.params.min_r * abs(top - floor)",
+        "test_min_stop_atr_widening_is_included_in_the_min_r_gate",
+    ),
+]
+
+
+def pytest(case: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+    return subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed interpreter and pytest arguments; case is a constant in this file
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", f"{TEST}::{case}"],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+def restore_any() -> None:
+    if not BACKUP.exists():
+        return
+    for parked in sorted(BACKUP.glob("*.bak")):
+        relpath = parked.with_suffix("").name.replace("__", "/")
+        (ROOT / relpath).write_bytes(parked.read_bytes())
+        parked.unlink()
+        sys.stdout.write(f"restored {relpath} from an interrupted run\n")
+    if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+        BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    restore_any()
+    baseline = subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed interpreter, pytest module and repository-owned test path
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", TEST],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    if baseline.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"trend box tests failed before mutation checks:\n{baseline.stdout}\n{baseline.stderr}"
+        )
+
+    BACKUP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    target = ROOT / TREND
+    results: list[str] = []
+    try:
+        clean = target.read_bytes()
+        parked = BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")
+        parked.write_bytes(clean)
+        for name, old, new, case in BUGS:
+            current = target.read_bytes()
+            if current.count(old) != 1 or old == new:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"mutation anchor is not unique for: {name}")
+            try:
+                target.write_bytes(current.replace(old, new, 1))
+                outcome = pytest(case)
+                caught = outcome.returncode != 0
+                results.append(f"{'CAUGHT' if caught else 'MISSED'} | {case} | {name}")
+            finally:
+                target.write_bytes(clean)
+        count = sum(result.startswith("CAUGHT") for result in results)
+        output = "\n".join([*results, f"{count}/{len(BUGS)} caught"]) + "\n"
+        (HERE / "plant_bugs_2_output.txt").write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
+        sys.stdout.write(output)
+        return 0 if count == len(BUGS) else 1
+    finally:
+        target.write_bytes((BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).read_bytes())
+        (BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+            BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Crash-safe mutation check for the two opt-in trend box levers.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv\\Scripts\\python research\\2026-10-26-three-bots\\plant_bugs_2.py``.
+Each mutation is restored byte-for-byte, including leftovers from an interrupted prior run.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess  # nosec B404 - runs this repo's own pytest
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BACKUP = HERE / ".plant_bugs_2_backup"
+TREND = "app/strategy/trend_box.py"
+TEST = "tests/unit/test_strategy_trend_box.py"
+
+BUGS: list[tuple[str, bytes, bytes, str]] = [
+    (
+        "enable the big time frame lever by default",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = False",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = True",
+        "test_big_tf_off_keeps_an_opposing_h4_out_of_the_decision",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let an up H4 trend pass a down box",
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "FLAT")',
+        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let a down H4 trend pass an up box",
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "DOWN")',
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        "test_big_tf_up_blocks_down_h4",
+    ),
+    (
+        "leave the H1 warmup too short to build 300 H4 bars",
+        b"return 1200 if self.params.require_big_tf else 400",
+        b"return 400",
+        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
+    ),
+    (
+        "accept only 299 closed H4 bars",
+        b"if len(h4) < 300:",
+        b"if len(h4) < 299:",
+        "test_big_tf_requires_300_closed_h4_bars",
+    ),

+        "allow a still-forming H4 bar into ZigZag",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at",

+        "test_min_stop_atr_widening_is_included_in_the_min_r_gate",

+
+def pytest(case: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+    return subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed interpreter and pytest arguments; case is a constant in this file
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", f"{TEST}::{case}"],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+def restore_any() -> None:
+    if not BACKUP.exists():
+        return
+    for parked in sorted(BACKUP.glob("*.bak")):
+        relpath = parked.with_suffix("").name.replace("__", "/")
+        (ROOT / relpath).write_bytes(parked.read_bytes())
+        parked.unlink()
+        sys.stdout.write(f"restored {relpath} from an interrupted run\n")
+    if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+        BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    restore_any()
+    baseline = subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed interpreter, pytest module and repository-owned test path
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", TEST],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    if baseline.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"trend box tests failed before mutation checks:\n{baseline.stdout}\n{baseline.stderr}"
+        )
+
+    BACKUP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    target = ROOT / TREND
+    results: list[str] = []
+    try:
+        clean = target.read_bytes()
+        parked = BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")
+        parked.write_bytes(clean)
+        for name, old, new, case in BUGS:
+            current = target.read_bytes()
+            if current.count(old) != 1 or old == new:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"mutation anchor is not unique for: {name}")
+            try:
+                target.write_bytes(current.replace(old, new, 1))
+                outcome = pytest(case)
+                caught = outcome.returncode != 0
+                results.append(f"{'CAUGHT' if caught else 'MISSED'} | {case} | {name}")
+            finally:
+                target.write_bytes(clean)
+        count = sum(result.startswith("CAUGHT") for result in results)
+        output = "\n".join([*results, f"{count}/{len(BUGS)} caught"]) + "\n"
+        (HERE / "plant_bugs_2_output.txt").write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
+        sys.stdout.write(output)
+        return 0 if count == len(BUGS) else 1
+    finally:
+        target.write_bytes((BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).read_bytes())
+        (BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+            BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+    idx = pd.date_range(end=end.replace(minute=0), periods=bars, freq="1h")
+    h1 = pd.DataFrame({"open": 100.0, "high": high, "low": 99.0, "close": 100.0}, index=idx)
+    return StrategyContext(ctx.market, {**ctx.frames, Timeframe.H1: h1}, ctx.now_utc)

+def test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "zigzag", lambda *_args: (down_swings(), None))
+    ctx = _with_h1(_tiny_box_context(), high=101.0)
+    params = TrendBoxDown.Params(min_stop_atr=1.0)
+    got = TrendBoxDown(params).evaluate(ctx)
+    # Constant H=101, L=99, C=100 yields a 2.00 Wilder ATR; the stop must sit 2.00 above 99.49.
+    assert got.action is Action.SELL and got.stop_loss == pytest.approx(101.49)
+    assert next(condition.detail for condition in got.conditions if condition.name == "stop_floor") == "2.00"
+
+    wide_ctx = context()
+    wide = TrendBoxDown(params).evaluate(_with_h1(wide_ctx, high=101.0))
+    assert wide.action is Action.SELL and wide.stop_loss == pytest.approx(112.0)
+    assert not any(condition.name == "stop_floor" for condition in wide.conditions)
+

+def test_min_stop_atr_mirrors_the_buy_stop_direction(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
+    up = [Swing(1, 100, -1), Swing(2, 110, 1), Swing(3, 101, -1), Swing(4, 120, 1)]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "zigzag", lambda *_args: (up, None))
+    ctx = context()

+    m1 = ctx.frame(Timeframe.M1).copy()

+    got = TrendBoxUp(TrendBoxUp.Params(min_stop_atr=1.5)).evaluate(ctx)
+    # ATR=2.00, so this BUY's 3.00 floor moves the stop to 108.10 - 3.00.

+    assert next(condition.detail for condition in got.conditions if condition.name == "stop_floor") == "3.00"

+def test_min_stop_atr_does_not_widen_a_stop_exactly_at_the_floor(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):

+# DEV_NOTES_2
+
+Date: 2026-10-27
+
+## Implementation
+
+- **Lever A (`require_big_tf`, default `False`)**: Added the shared parameter and increased H1 warmup to 1,200 only when enabled, enough to form 300 H4 bars. After the H1 stepping gate, the strategy calls `RangeBreak._h4_from_h1`, filters closed bars with `(index + 4h) <= decision time`, and checks confirmed swings via the existing `stepped()` helper. An opposing direction holds with `H4_AGAINST`; FLAT and aligned directions pass. The import is local to `evaluate()` because `range_break` already imports helpers from `trend_box`; this avoids a module import cycle and reuses the one resampling implementation.
+- **Lever B (`min_stop_atr`, default `0.0`)**: Added a nonnegative shared parameter. When enabled, the strategy calls `app.indicators.volatility.atr` on closed H1 bars, using its existing 14 period Wilder smoothing. It widens only stops closer than the computed floor, before reward/risk checks, and adds `stop_floor` only when widening occurred. No duplicate ATR implementation was needed.
+- No spec contradiction was found. The only integration detail was the existing `range_break`/`trend_box` import direction, handled by the local import above.
+
+## New tests and mutation proof
+
+Every new behavior test calls `evaluate()`; expected ATR distances are hand-worked from constant 2.00 H1 ranges. `plant_bugs_2.py` runs one targeted test per mutation and restores `trend_box.py` byte-for-byte in `finally`.
+
+| New test | Mutation that proves it bites |
+|---|---|
+| `test_big_tf_off_keeps_an_opposing_h4_out_of_the_decision` | Set `require_big_tf` default to `True`. |
+| `test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry` | Let H4 UP pass; shorten H1 warmup to 400. |
+| `test_big_tf_up_blocks_down_h4` | Let H4 DOWN pass. Also checks FLAT and UP entries. |
+| `test_big_tf_requires_300_closed_h4_bars` | Lower the minimum to 299. |
+| `test_big_tf_does_not_send_a_forming_h4_bar_to_zigzag` | Include an H4 bar whose close is four hours after the decision. |
+| `test_min_stop_atr_off_leaves_a_tiny_box_stop_unchanged` | Set the `min_stop_atr` default to 1.0. |
+| `test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor` | Halve the floor; omit the stop-floor condition. Checks an already-wide stop stays unchanged. |
+| `test_min_stop_atr_mirrors_the_buy_stop_direction` | Move a BUY stop to `price + floor`. |
+| `test_min_stop_atr_does_not_widen_a_stop_exactly_at_the_floor` | Change strict `<` to `<=`. |
+| `test_min_stop_atr_widening_is_included_in_the_min_r_gate` | Check reward against box width instead of the widened risk. |
+
+The final planted-bug run caught **12/12**; the full per-mutation results are in [plant_bugs_2_output.txt](plant_bugs_2_output.txt). An earlier mutation iteration missed the 299 bar boundary and widened-risk checks. I tightened those cases, and both mutations were caught in the final run. There were no final MISSED mutations.
+

+"""Crash-safe mutation check for the two opt-in trend box levers.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv\\Scripts\\python research\\2026-10-26-three-bots\\plant_bugs_2.py``.
+Each mutation is restored byte-for-byte, including leftovers from an interrupted prior run.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess  # nosec B404 - runs this repo's own pytest
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BACKUP = HERE / ".plant_bugs_2_backup"
+TREND = "app/strategy/trend_box.py"
+TEST = "tests/unit/test_strategy_trend_box.py"
+
+BUGS: list[tuple[str, bytes, bytes, str]] = [
+    (
+        "enable the big time frame lever by default",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = False",

+        "leave the H1 warmup too short to build 300 H4 bars",

+        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
+    ),
+    (
+        "accept only 299 closed H4 bars",
+        b"if len(h4) < 300:",
+        b"if len(h4) < 299:",
+        "test_big_tf_requires_300_closed_h4_bars",

+        "allow a still-forming H4 bar into ZigZag",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at",

+
+def pytest(case: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+    return subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed interpreter and pytest arguments; case is a constant in this file
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", f"{TEST}::{case}"],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+def restore_any() -> None:
+    if not BACKUP.exists():
+        return
+    for parked in sorted(BACKUP.glob("*.bak")):
+        relpath = parked.with_suffix("").name.replace("__", "/")
+        (ROOT / relpath).write_bytes(parked.read_bytes())
+        parked.unlink()
+        sys.stdout.write(f"restored {relpath} from an interrupted run\n")
+    if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+        BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    restore_any()
+    baseline = subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed interpreter, pytest module and repository-owned test path
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", TEST],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    if baseline.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"trend box tests failed before mutation checks:\n{baseline.stdout}\n{baseline.stderr}"
+        )
+
+    BACKUP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    target = ROOT / TREND
+    results: list[str] = []
+    try:
+        clean = target.read_bytes()
+        parked = BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")
+        parked.write_bytes(clean)
+        for name, old, new, case in BUGS:
+            current = target.read_bytes()
+            if current.count(old) != 1 or old == new:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"mutation anchor is not unique for: {name}")
+            try:
+                target.write_bytes(current.replace(old, new, 1))
+                outcome = pytest(case)
+                caught = outcome.returncode != 0
+                results.append(f"{'CAUGHT' if caught else 'MISSED'} | {case} | {name}")
+            finally:
+                target.write_bytes(clean)
+        count = sum(result.startswith("CAUGHT") for result in results)
+        output = "\n".join([*results, f"{count}/{len(BUGS)} caught"]) + "\n"
+        (HERE / "plant_bugs_2_output.txt").write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
+        sys.stdout.write(output)
+        return 0 if count == len(BUGS) else 1
+    finally:
+        target.write_bytes((BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).read_bytes())
+        (BACKUP / (TREND.replace("/", "__") + ".bak")).unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        if BACKUP.exists() and not any(BACKUP.iterdir()):
+            BACKUP.rmdir()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+def test_big_tf_does_not_send_a_forming_h4_bar_to_zigzag(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):

+# DEV_NOTES_2
+
+Date: 2026-10-27
+
+## Implementation
+
+- **Lever A (`require_big_tf`, default `False`)**: Added the shared parameter and increased H1 warmup to 1,200 only when enabled, enough to form 300 H4 bars. After the H1 stepping gate, the strategy calls `RangeBreak._h4_from_h1`, filters closed bars with `(index + 4h) <= decision time`, and checks confirmed swings via the existing `stepped()` helper. An opposing direction holds with `H4_AGAINST`; FLAT and aligned directions pass. The import is local to `evaluate()` because `range_break` already imports helpers from `trend_box`; this avoids a module import cycle and reuses the one resampling implementation.
+- **Lever B (`min_stop_atr`, default `0.0`)**: Added a nonnegative shared parameter. When enabled, the strategy calls `app.indicators.volatility.atr` on closed H1 bars, using its existing 14 period Wilder smoothing. It widens only stops closer than the computed floor, before reward/risk checks, and adds `stop_floor` only when widening occurred. No duplicate ATR implementation was needed.
+- No spec contradiction was found. The only integration detail was the existing `range_break`/`trend_box` import direction, handled by the local import above.
+
+## New tests and mutation proof
+
+Every new behavior test calls `evaluate()`; expected ATR distances are hand-worked from constant 2.00 H1 ranges. `plant_bugs_2.py` runs one targeted test per mutation and restores `trend_box.py` byte-for-byte in `finally`.
+
+| New test | Mutation that proves it bites |
+|---|---|
+| `test_big_tf_off_keeps_an_opposing_h4_out_of_the_decision` | Set `require_big_tf` default to `True`. |
+| `test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry` | Let H4 UP pass; shorten H1 warmup to 400. |
+| `test_big_tf_up_blocks_down_h4` | Let H4 DOWN pass. Also checks FLAT and UP entries. |
+| `test_big_tf_requires_300_closed_h4_bars` | Lower the minimum to 299. |
+| `test_big_tf_does_not_send_a_forming_h4_bar_to_zigzag` | Include an H4 bar whose close is four hours after the decision. |
+| `test_min_stop_atr_off_leaves_a_tiny_box_stop_unchanged` | Set the `min_stop_atr` default to 1.0. |
+| `test_min_stop_atr_widens_only_narrow_stops_and_reports_floor` | Halve the floor; omit the stop-floor condition. Checks an already-wide stop stays unchanged. |
+| `test_min_stop_atr_mirrors_the_buy_stop_direction` | Move a BUY stop to `price + floor`. |
+| `test_min_stop_atr_does_not_widen_a_stop_exactly_at_the_floor` | Change strict `<` to `<=`. |
+| `test_min_stop_atr_widening_is_included_in_the_min_r_gate` | Check reward against box width instead of the widened risk. |
+
+The final planted-bug run caught **12/12**; the full per-mutation results are in [plant_bugs_2_output.txt](plant_bugs_2_output.txt). An earlier mutation iteration missed the 299 bar boundary and widened-risk checks. I tightened those cases, and both mutations were caught in the final run. There were no final MISSED mutations.
+
+## Default behavior proof
+
+- Before adding the ten tests, the suite collected 3,947 cases: 3,937 passed, 9 skipped, and the API sample check failed because the public strategy response now includes the two new default parameters. I regenerated the shared response fixture; its focused test then passed.
+- After implementation and fixture update, the full suite passed: **3,948 passed, 9 skipped** (3,957 collected). The strategy-focused files passed **47/47**. The two new fields default to `False` and `0.0`; existing parameter defaults and `config.yaml` are unchanged. With both levers off, no H4 resampling or ATR calculation runs.
+- The parity script reported the same rates before and after the changes: `trend_box_down` 35/38 (92.1%), `trend_box_up` 21/23 (91.3%), and `range_break` 39/41 (95.1%). This confirms the default-off path retains the current parity match rates.
+

+"""Crash-safe mutation check for the two opt-in trend box levers.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv\\Scripts\\python research\\2026-10-26-three-bots\\plant_bugs_2.py``.
+Each mutation is restored byte-for-byte, including leftovers from an interrupted prior run.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess  # nosec B404 - runs this repo's own pytest
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BACKUP = HERE / ".plant_bugs_2_backup"
+TREND = "app/strategy/trend_box.py"
+TEST = "tests/unit/test_strategy_trend_box.py"
+
+BUGS: list[tuple[str, bytes, bytes, str]] = [
+    (
+        "enable the big time frame lever by default",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = False",
+        b"require_big_tf: bool = True",
+        "test_big_tf_off_keeps_an_opposing_h4_out_of_the_decision",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let an up H4 trend pass a down box",
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        b'(down and h4_direction == "FLAT")',
+        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
+    ),
+    (
+        "let a down H4 trend pass an up box",
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "DOWN")',
+        b'(not down and h4_direction == "UP")',
+        "test_big_tf_up_blocks_down_h4",
+    ),
+    (
+        "leave the H1 warmup too short to build 300 H4 bars",
+        b"return 1200 if self.params.require_big_tf else 400",
+        b"return 400",
+        "test_big_tf_down_blocks_up_h4_but_flat_and_down_keep_the_entry",
+    ),
+    (
+        "accept only 299 closed H4 bars",
+        b"if len(h4) < 300:",
+        b"if len(h4) < 299:",
+        "test_big_tf_requires_300_closed_h4_bars",
+    ),
+    (
+        "allow a still-forming H4 bar into ZigZag",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at",
+        b"(h4.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)",
+        "test_big_tf_does_not_send_a_forming_h4_bar_to_zigzag",
+    ),
+    (
